newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria M1 up 7.27 pct, M2 down 8.42 pct in week.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria M1 up 7.27 pct, M2 down 8.42 pct in week.

text.p: Bulgarian M1 money supply rose to 427.9 billion levs on March 14 from 398.9 billion levs a week earlier and M2 fell to 2,833.6 billion levs from 3,094.2 billion levs, preliminary central bank figures showed.
Total broad money decreased 8.32 percent to 3,055.2 billion levs in the week to March 14.
Lev-denominated broad money rose 6.39 percent to 932.2 billion levs while dollar-denominated broad money fell 13.57 percent to 2,123 billion levs.

Hard currency-denominated deposits of companies totalled $759.9 million on March 14, down from $760.1 million a week earlier, while individuals' foreign currency deposits rose by $3.7 million to $467.7 million, figures showed.
Lev-denominated deposits of individuals edged up to 77.8 billion levs on March 14 from 77.5 billion levs the week before.
The lev rose to 1,569.0 to the dollar on March 14 in the central bank fixing used in the calculations from 1,825.0 on March 7. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, (++359-2) 981 8569
